About

The marketer behind the blog

I'm Samran Kiyani, a digital marketer based in Jhelum, Pakistan. I run Samran Blogs — Digital Marketing Tips, where I break down SEO, social media and email marketing into simple, practical guides for small business owners.

On Instagram, as @samran_marketer, I design posters, carousels and reels for clients in Canva — including a published series on how I design a client poster, step by step. The same hands-on approach goes into every client project: plan first, design carefully, and report honestly.

Whether you hire me for a service or just read the blog, the goal is the same: marketing you can understand, afford, and actually see working.
